title: Model Operations
subtitle: Govern owned models, their signed-model admission and local inference deployments.

owned.title: Owned models
owned.description: The governed registry of models you own — hosted, fine-tuned or imported.
owned.formBody: Register a model you own. Governance metadata only — never a secret.
owned.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}”? Its versions and lineage references are removed. This is recorded in the audit ledger.

drawer.subtitle: Overview, versions and per-version admission evidence.

owned.truncatedHint: There are more registered models than shown; this page takes rows by id — assigned at creation — so rows beyond it are missing, normally the most recently registered. Table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded. A model not listed here does not demonstrate that it is unregistered.

versions.title: Versions
versions.emptyHint: Create a version to record an artifact and admit its signature.
versions.formBody: A version is immutable once created — record it, then admit its signed artifact.
versions.deleteBody: Delete version “{{version}}”? Its admission verdict is removed. This is recorded in the audit ledger.
versions.truncatedHint: This model has more versions than shown; the page takes rows by id, so later ones can be missing. A version you cannot see here is also a version whose admission evidence you cannot reach from this screen.
versions.loadError: The version list could not be read — this is NOT "no versions"

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.description: Local inference deployments across all models. Governed by the admission gate.
deployments.formBody: Point a runtime at a governed model version. Admission is enforced on save.
deployments.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}”? This is recorded in the audit ledger.
deployments.deniedHint: Admit the referenced version under the current trust anchors, then retry — your input is kept.

form.name: Name
form.governedHint: A declared posture flag — not an admission bypass.
form.deploymentTypeHint: Local serves a self-hosted model version and is admission-gated; brokered calls a hosted provider and is not.
form.providerHint: The hosted provider this deployment brokers to (e.g. an API endpoint).

deployments.truncatedHint: There are more deployments than shown; this page takes rows by id. The runtime and status filters are applied by the ENGINE, so they re-query — the cut is of the already-filtered set. A deployment not listed here does not demonstrate that nothing is running. Table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded.

policy.title: Admission policy
policy.description: The tenant trust policy for signed-model admission. The signing method is derived from what you configure.
policy.editBody: Author the trust anchors. Saved atomically; the engine remains the authority.
policy.loadError: Could not load the admission policy.
policy.requireSignedHint: Enforce: deny deployment of any version without a verified admission verdict.
policy.requireDigestsHint: Also require an on-disk re-hash of the signed artifacts to match.
policy.identitiesHint: One signer identity regex per line (Sigstore keyless).
policy.issuersHint: One OIDC issuer URL per line. Must be set together with identities, or neither.
policy.trustedRootsHint: PEM CA certificates (Fulcio or private PKI). Public material only.
policy.trustedKeysHint: PEM public keys for bare-key signatures. Public material only.
policy.confirmBody: Enabling enforcement or removing a trust anchor can make future deployment creates and updates fail until affected versions are re-admitted. Continue?

unconfigured.title: Observe mode — not configured
unconfigured.body: No policy is set. Admission verdicts are recorded but nothing is denied.

observe.title: Observe mode
observe.body: A policy is configured but enforcement is off. Verdicts are recorded; deployments are not denied.

enforce.title: Enforce mode
enforce.body: Deployment of a version without a verified, still-anchored admission verdict is denied.

err.privateKey: Trust material must be public — remove any PRIVATE KEY block.
err.pemResidual: Remove the incomplete PEM block — only whole BEGIN…END blocks are saved.
err.anchorMissing: Enforcement needs at least one trusted root or key.
err.identityIssuer: Identities and issuers must be set together, or neither.

verdicts.title: Admission verdicts
verdicts.description: The recorded CURRENT verdict, one per version — re-admitting REPLACES it, it does not add a row. A version with no attempt does not appear here.
verdicts.drawerSubtitle: The recorded verdict — each truth shown independently.
verdicts.truncatedHint: There are more admission verdicts than shown; this page takes rows by id. There is one verdict per version — re-admitting REPLACES it, it does not add a row, and the id keeps the FIRST attempt's position — so a version missing here has not necessarily gone unadmitted.

admit.title: Admit a signed model
admit.body: Verify and record a signature for version {{version}}. A recorded verdict is evidence, admitted or not.
admit.bundleHint: The raw OMS / Sigstore bundle JSON.
admit.digestsHint: Optional map of file → hex digest, to re-hash the on-disk artifact.
admit.digestsInvalid: Expected a JSON object of string values.
admit.recordedNotAdmitted: Verdict recorded, but the signature did not satisfy the policy.

evidence.noneHint: Admit this version to record a signature verdict.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: AIBOM lineage components — a name, a content reference and a hash. Never the data itself.
datasets.formBody: A minimal-data lineage record: identity, classification and a content reference — never the dataset contents.
datasets.deleteBody: Delete “{{name}}”? Its lineage reference is removed, which changes future BOMs (never a past seal). This is recorded in the audit ledger.
datasets.drawerSubtitle: Lineage record — classification, content reference and provenance claim.
datasets.provenanceClaimed: Operator assertion recorded — the operator states the recorded provenance was reviewed. Olivares did not cryptographically verify the dataset or inspect its contents.
datasets.provenanceNotClaimed: No provenance assertion recorded by the operator.

form.name: Name
form.ownedRefHint: Optional — link this dataset to an owned model. Must resolve, or the save is refused.
form.contentAlgHint: Defaults to sha256 when a hash is set.
form.verifiedHint: Assert that you reviewed this dataset's provenance. This records an operator claim — not verification performed by Olivares. There is no update: correcting it means delete and recreate.

datasets.truncatedHint: There are more registered datasets than shown; this page takes rows by id. These rows are AI-BOM lineage components: a dataset missing here does not demonstrate that the lineage lacks it. Table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded.

finetune.title: Fine-tune jobs
finetune.description: Records of fine-tuning jobs and the versions they produced. The plane never trains a model or holds weights.
finetune.formBody: Record a job's state and the version it produced. This is an inventory record — the control plane does not run training.
finetune.trackBanner: This records externally run fine-tuning work. Olivares does not start, cancel, or execute training and stores no weights or dataset contents.

form.name: Name
form.resultVersionRefHint: The model version this job produced. Must resolve to an existing version, or the save is refused.
form.clearHint: Clearing a recorded timestamp has no effect — the engine keeps the previous value.

finetune.truncatedHint: There are more fine-tune records than shown; this page takes rows by id. The status filter is applied by the ENGINE, so it re-queries. A job not listed here does not demonstrate that it never ran. Table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded.

evidenceLedger.title: AIBOM seals
evidenceLedger.description: The sealed AIBOM ledger across all models — durable, append-only, ledger-anchored tamper-evidence. Each row is a content-hash commitment, not the BOM document.
evidenceLedger.drawerSubtitle: A sealed AIBOM — the tamper-evidence anchored to the audit ledger.
evidenceLedger.sealMeaning: A seal is an append-only content-hash commitment anchored to the audit ledger — not an archive of the BOM. The full document is not stored and cannot be retrieved from a seal.
evidenceLedger.truncatedHint: There are more sealed AI-BOMs than shown. This page takes rows by id — assigned at creation — so rows beyond it are missing, which in normal operation means recent evidence. Table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded. A model with no seal here does not demonstrate that it was never sealed.

documents.liveSubtitle: Generated now from the current registry state. Not sealed and not audited.
documents.receiptBody: The ledger stores only the content hash — the sealed CycloneDX document exists only here. Download it now to keep a copy.
documents.noSealsHint: Seal the AIBOM to anchor a content-hash commitment to the audit ledger.
documents.sealConfirmBody: Create an append-only CycloneDX content-hash commitment from the current registry state? This does not archive the BOM document.

aibom.title: AIBOM
aibom.sealHint: Sealing creates an append-only CycloneDX content-hash commitment anchored to the audit ledger. It does not archive the BOM document. Always CycloneDX — the SPDX export can never be sealed.
aibom.previewBody: A live, read-only CycloneDX (or SPDX) inventory — not sealed until you seal it.

card.title: Model card
card.previewBody: Generated from the governed inventory. Sections without recorded evidence are marked not recorded — never fabricated.
card.name: Name

documents.sealsTruncatedHint: This model has more seals than shown; the page takes rows by id, so later rows — normally the latest seal — can be missing. The absence of a hash here does not demonstrate that the document was never sealed.
documents.sealsLoadError: The seal history could not be read — this is NOT "no seals"

datasets.title: No datasets recorded yet
datasets.description: Record a dataset's identity and classification, with an optional content reference and hash, to add it to AIBOM lineage without storing its contents.

deployments.title: No inference deployments recorded yet
deployments.description: Record a local or brokered inference deployment; a local entry needs an existing model version, and is gated only where an admission policy requires signing.

finetune.title: No fine-tune job records yet
finetune.description: Record a fine-tune job run outside Olivares to track its state, lineage and produced model version; the control plane does not run training.

modelEvidence.title: No AIBOM seals recorded yet
modelEvidence.description: Open an owned model and seal its AIBOM to anchor an append-only content-hash commitment to the audit ledger.

ownedModels.title: No owned models registered yet
ownedModels.description: Register a hosted, fine-tuned or imported model to manage its versions, admission evidence and AIBOM documents.

verdict.title: No admission verdicts recorded yet
verdict.description: Create a version under an owned model, then admit its signed artifact. Each version keeps one verdict, replaced when it is admitted again.
